Please make the corrections before implementation:

- Add the single shared collection behavior to the specification itself, including bookmarks, tags, saved views, and display preferences remaining available across restarts and new browser visits without session-specific profiles.
- Strengthen the bulk-action requirement to name the complete current view: search, included and excluded tags, unread/archive state, an open saved view, and all pages.
- Ensure a bulk action from a saved view uses that exact saved view—or its complete filters—so the affected count and the changed items exactly match what I am viewing.
- Add a large-collection check for the promised bulk-action performance.

The current story ordering is fine. Please update the affected specification, plan, contract, and tasks, then show me the revised result before implementation.
